objective:
Wire the question reader's new date words and question kind (DH4.2) through the lookup into the Explore screen, so that e.g. "how many times did I mow in August?" sets the chips to August 2026 + Lawn + Mow and shows a count answer, "how often do I change the oil?" shows the typical gap, and "what did I do last week?" (no subject/action) just sets the date chip. All dates and numbers come from program logic (TemporalRangeResolver from DH4.1 and the existing ExploreCalculator); the model only supplies words.

Read first: core-domain lookup/LookupService.kt (QuestionCandidate with dateWindow/kind, LookupOutcome, LookupService.ask), lookup/QuestionKind.kt, lookup/HistoryLookup.kt (QuestionDetector, rank, LookupTarget/LookupTier), lookup tests (LookupServiceTest), temporal/TemporalRangeResolver.kt + TemporalRange.kt, stats/DateRange.kt and stats/ExploreTypes.kt (ExploreSummary: entriesInPeriod, lastTime, typicalGap (ONE_ACTIVITY only), scopeKind, range), naming/NameNormalizer.kt; app-phone ui/explore/ExploreViewModel.kt (ask, onAnswer, changeFilter, recompute, questionAnswer), ExploreUiState.kt (ExploreAnswer), ExploreResults.kt (AnswerLine, scopeText, rangePhrase, gapText, relativeDayText, ExploreDates.longDate), ExploreText.kt / ExploreFormatting.kt, the existing explore_* strings in res/values/strings.xml, and the ui/explore tests incl. ExploreTestFixtures.kt. Design: docs/proposals/explore/DESIGN_SPEC.md 'Screen design' 1 and 3, 'Counting rules'.

PART A -- core-domain lookup (pure, no clock reads, no logging of question text):
1. `LookupService.ask(questionText: String, today: LocalDate, firstDayOfWeek: DayOfWeek): LookupOutcome` replaces the one-argument ask (the only production caller is ExploreViewModel; update LookupServiceTest calls with a fixed today). LookupService gets a `TemporalRangeResolver` (constructor parameter with a default instance).
2. New `QuestionKindDetector` object (lookup package): deterministic kind from the question TEXT, checked before the model's kind (program logic outranks model output). On the normalized text (NameNormalizer.normalize, curly apostrophe -> plain): contains 'how many' or 'how much' or 'number of times' -> COUNT; 'how often', 'how regularly', 'how frequently' -> HOW_OFTEN; 'when did i last', 'when was the last', 'last time i', 'did i ever', 'have i ever', 'when did i' -> LAST_TIME; starts with 'what did i', 'what have i', 'what else did i', 'show me', 'list' -> LIST; otherwise null. Order of checks as listed (COUNT before HOW_OFTEN before LAST_TIME before LIST). Whole-word/phrase matching on word boundaries.
3. Final kind = detector result ?: candidate.kind (if not UNKNOWN) ?: UNKNOWN.
4. Date words, untrusted: candidate.dateWindow is used only if, after normalizing both (lowercase, collapse whitespace, trim punctuation, curly apostrophe -> plain), it occurs as a substring of the normalized question text; otherwise it is treated as absent (the model invented it). Then TemporalRangeResolver.resolve(words, today, firstDayOfWeek): Resolved -> that selection, DateWords.USED; NoWindow (or absent) -> Preset(ALL_TIME), DateWords.NONE (plan P2); Unrecognised -> Preset(ALL_TIME), DateWords.NOT_UNDERSTOOD; Future -> the outcome is NotEnoughHistory (nothing can be logged in the future).
5. New `QuestionScope(val kind: QuestionKind, val range: DateRangeSelection, val dateWords: DateWords)` and `enum class DateWords { NONE, USED, NOT_UNDERSTOOD }` (lookup package).
6. Outcomes: `LookupOutcome.Answer(target, result, scope: QuestionScope)` (scope added as a third property). New `LookupOutcome.Browse(scope: QuestionScope)`: returned when the candidate names neither a subject nor an action (both null) AND (dateWords == USED or kind == LIST), and at least one entry is logged (else NotEnoughHistory). All other existing rules and their order stay exactly as they are (blank/not-a-question -> NotAQuestion before any extractor call; failure mapping; a named subject that matches no tag -> NotEnoughHistory; no target -> NotEnoughHistory unless Browse applies; no entries -> NotEnoughHistory; ranking via HistoryLookup.rank unchanged; nothing ranked -> NotEnoughHistory). A Future date window -> NotEnoughHistory (checked after extraction, before tag resolution). Update the class KDoc and file comment (ADR-051: questions now return filter values; the model still never produces a date, count or answer).
7. Tests (LookupServiceTest + new QuestionKindDetectorTest): every detector phrase and its precedence, null for other text; detector beats model kind; model kind used when detector returns null; UNKNOWN when neither; date words resolved ("in August" with today 2026-10-05 -> Custom Aug 1-31 2026 labelled Month, USED); date words not present in the question text -> ignored (ALL_TIME, NONE); unrecognised words -> ALL_TIME + NOT_UNDERSTOOD; future words -> NotEnoughHistory; no date words -> ALL_TIME + NONE; Browse for 'what did I do last week?' with no subject/action; Browse not returned when nothing logged; no subject/action and no date words and kind not LIST -> NotEnoughHistory as before; all previous LookupServiceTest expectations still hold (adjusted only for the new parameters/property).

PART B -- app-phone Explore:
8. ExploreViewModel.ask passes today (clock.instant() in zoneProvider()) and firstDayOfWeekProvider() to lookup.ask.
9. On Answer: push the current filter; filter = ExploreFilter(range = scope.range, subjectId/actionId from the target, words = null); view = ENTRIES; askedQuestion kept. The answer line is chosen by kind: HOW_OFTEN -> HowOften; COUNT, or (dateWords == USED and kind is LAST_TIME, LIST or UNKNOWN) -> Count; otherwise (LAST_TIME/LIST/UNKNOWN with no date words) -> LastTime exactly as today. Count and HowOften facts are filled from the ExploreSummary computed for the new filter (store the pending question spec -- kind, names, closestMatch, dateWords -- and build the answer in recompute when the summary arrives; until then isLoading as today). Facts: Count(subjectName, actionName, count = summary.entriesInPeriod, range = filter.range, lastTime = summary.lastTime, closestMatch, datesNotUnderstood); HowOften(subjectName, actionName, typicalGap = summary.typicalGap, entriesAllTime = summary.totalEntriesEver, lastTime = summary.lastTime, closestMatch, datesNotUnderstood). LastTime gains `datesNotUnderstood: Boolean = false`. Names and closestMatch come from the ranked top entry as today. datesNotUnderstood = (dateWords == NOT_UNDERSTOOD).
10. On Browse: push the current filter; filter = ExploreFilter(range = scope.range) (no tags, no words); view = ENTRIES; answer = Scope as for any filter (no question answer kept), except when dateWords == NOT_UNDERSTOOD (only possible with kind LIST): then keep the Scope answer and set a `datesNotUnderstood` flag on Scope (new Boolean property, default false) so the note shows.
11. Any later manual filter change still replaces a question answer with Scope (existing rule); clearAll, back, late-answer dropping and stale-computation guards unchanged.
12. UI (ExploreResults AnswerLine + strings.xml), same style as the existing 'Last logged: Subject · Action — date (ago)' line, names joined with ' · ' (one name when only one side is set), dates via ExploreDates.longDate + relativeDayText, range wording via the existing rangePhrase (month/year labels already word as 'August 2026' / '2026'):
   - Count, count > 0: plural explore_answer_count: "%1$s: %2$d time in %3$s." / "%1$s: %2$d times in %3$s." (1 = names, 3 = range phrase), then a second sentence when lastTime != null: explore_answer_last "Last: %1$s (%2$s)." in the same Text.
   - Count, count == 0: explore_answer_count_none "%1$s: none in %2$s." + the Last sentence if lastTime != null.
   - HowOften with a typicalGap: explore_answer_how_often "%1$s: usually %2$s." (2 = gapText(gap), e.g. 'every 7 days' -- check gapText's output form and adapt the template so it reads naturally; gapText may already include 'every') + Last sentence.
   - HowOften without a gap: plural explore_answer_how_often_too_few "%1$s: not enough entries yet to say how often (%2$d so far)." + Last sentence.
   - Notes under the line (QuietText), in this order: the existing closest-match notes; then, when datesNotUnderstood, explore_note_dates_not_understood "Couldn't tell which dates you meant, so this covers all your history."
   - Scope with datesNotUnderstood shows the same note under the scope line (the scope line is currently shown elsewhere -- see lines ~118-128 of ExploreResults: make sure the note appears wherever the Scope line is shown, without duplicating the scope line).
   - The answer stays in the polite live region.
13. Tests (Robolectric, ui/explore, using ExploreTestFixtures' fake extractor which must now be able to return dateWindow and kind -- extend the fixture): COUNT question with 'in August' sets range Custom Aug 2026 + tags + ENTRIES + Count answer with the calculator's count and last time; 'Did I … in May?' (LAST_TIME + date words) -> Count; LAST_TIME without date words -> LastTime + ALL_TIME (existing behaviour); HOW_OFTEN with >=3 entries -> HowOften with the gap; with <3 -> gap null and entriesAllTime; unrecognised date words -> datesNotUnderstood true and ALL_TIME; date words not in the question text -> ignored; future words -> NotEnoughHistory and filters unchanged; Browse sets only the range (and back() restores); a manual chip change after a Count answer switches to Scope; Compose tests for the Count line (incl. zero), the HowOften line (both forms) and the dates-not-understood note. All existing explore tests keep passing (update them only for the new ask signature / Answer property).

Rules that must hold: model output untrusted -- date words are checked against the question text and only resolved by TemporalRangeResolver; kind from text rules outranks the model; the model never produces a date, count or answer (ADR-011, ADR-051, ADR-052); no question/search text persisted or logged (AGENTS.md #11); Explore never writes to the repository; ML Kit stays in core-ai.
non_goals: No change to core-ai, the question prompt/schema, TemporalRangeResolver, the stats calculator rules, HistoryLookup ranking, or the activity capture path.
No question corpus or replay gate (DH4.4).
No change to the watch app or to the navigation/tabs.
No new date-range presets or chip behaviour beyond setting the range from a question.
acceptance_criteria: LookupService.ask(questionText, today, firstDayOfWeek) resolves kind (text rules first, then model kind, else UNKNOWN) and the date window (only words that occur in the question text; TemporalRangeResolver; NoWindow -> ALL_TIME/NONE, Unrecognised -> ALL_TIME/NOT_UNDERSTOOD, Future -> NotEnoughHistory) into a QuestionScope carried by Answer; Browse is returned for date-only/LIST questions with no subject/action when entries exist; every pre-existing rule and its order is unchanged.
QuestionKindDetector implements the listed phrases with the stated precedence and word boundaries; tests cover each.

ExploreViewModel sets the chips from the scope (range from the question, tags from the target), picks Count / HowOften / LastTime by the stated rule, fills counts, last time and typical gap only from the ExploreSummary computed for the new filter, and handles Browse and datesNotUnderstood as specified; manual changes, clearAll, back, late-answer and stale-result rules unchanged.

The answer line words Count (incl. zero), HowOften (with and without a gap) and the dates-not-understood note as specified, in the existing style and live region; all copy is in strings.xml (plurals where a number is shown).
No model output reaches the UI or the filters except through tag resolution and TemporalRangeResolver; no question text is stored or logged; no repository write.
Tests listed in steps 7 and 13 exist and pass; ./gradlew :core-domain:test :app-phone:testDebugUnitTest passes in full and ./gradlew :app-phone:assembleDebug succeeds.
No file outside write_paths is changed.
